I reviewed the undici source (`lib/`), focusing on areas that handle untrusted network input: cookie parsing, header/redirect handling, multipart/FormData encoding and parsing, EventSource/WebSocket handshakes, TLS connection setup, and the fetch referrer/CORS logic. 2. **`lib/web/fetch/body.js` (`extractBody`, CWE-330)** — multipart boundaries are generated with `Math.random()` (low entropy, non-cryptographic) and field values aren't escaped for embedded boundary sequences, allowing multipart form-field injection if an attacker-controlled value is forwarded in a FormData body.
